svg.title: Sign in with AgentBuff for a partner app
svg.desc: 1. The partner app redirects to agentbuff.id/masuk/authorize with a code challenge (PKCE), state and nonce. 2. AgentBuff checks the session, then that the account is not blocked, has an active plan or trial, and owns the app. 3. On the first visit the owner confirms on a consent screen; the app receives a single-use code valid for 5 minutes. 4. The app exchanges the code for an ES256-signed ID token with a random per-app user id; the AgentBuff user id is never shared. 5. The app calls a status endpoint periodically, so an owner whose plan lapses is paused without losing data.
